title: Published-knowledge lane rejects any extra file under .bbox/graphs/<id>/ (apply plans), stalling publication for the whole project
wanted_capability: A committed design-graph apply plan (the sanctioned provenance artifact under .bbox/graphs/design/plans/, per the design-graph operating conventions) must not make the project's published-knowledge lane fail. Today the host collector enumerates every file under .bbox/graphs/ into the Graphs-lane manifest and the knowledge-source contract validator admits only <graph-id>/{graph.json,schema.json,vertices.jsonl,edges.jsonl}; a third path component or any other filename raises InvalidGraphSourcePath, the whole lane pass for the project fails ("lane pass failed for project; continuing with the rest"), no kps candidate is produced, and the granted auto-advance never fires. Consequence observed 2026-08-18/19: the accepted publication pointer sat at 45606cdf while beta/blackbox-v2 advanced through 906c3ef5, 958c69ae, 075a0077, 7219e8aa; 24 gaps closed in those commits still render as open in the served view; bbox_gap_update on any post-45606cdf gap fails with Gap not found; the design graph migration itself (generation 32) is invisible to the daemon. Wanted: (1) collector-side manifest enumeration limited to the known graph files (or an explicit ignore for a plans/ subdirectory), (2) validator tolerance or a documented reserved location for plan provenance outside the graph directory, and (3) the per-project lane failure surfaced through publisher_status / inbox instead of a 60MB host log (that half is gap-0b3777f5).
missing_primitive: Graphs-lane manifest enumeration that filters to the four known graph files (or a validator that tolerates non-graph provenance files under a graph directory) plus a loud per-project failure signal
fallback_used: Diagnosed by hand from publisher_status plus a host log grep. Interim unblock proposed to the operator: relocate the committed plan file out of the graph directory (and amend the plans convention) so the next collector cycle produces a candidate; substrate fix to follow.
evidence: host collector log: repeated ERROR lane=published-knowledge root=<primary checkout> error=graph source path is not exactly <graph-id>/<known-file>, every ~2 min from 2026-08-18T22:57Z onward
